mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS plant ( pid VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, pname VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, ptype VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, pdatetime VARCHAR(50), pprice INT DEFAULT 0, ppic VARCHAR(500), pdesc TEXT, area_id INT DEFAULT NULL, latitude DOUBLE DEFAULT NULL, longitude DOUBLE DEFAULT NULL, trim_period_days INT DEFAULT NULL, fertilize_period_days INT DEFAULT NULL, water_period_days INT DEFAULT NULL, pest_period_days INT DEFAULT NULL, next_trim_date DATE DEFAULT NULL, next_fertilize_date DATE DEFAULT NULL, next_water_date DATE DEFAULT NULL, next_pest_date DATE DEFAULT NULL ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS type ( tid VARCHAR(50) PRIMARY KEY, tname VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, tdesc VARCHAR(500) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS plant_maintenance ( mid INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, pid VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, pname VARCHAR(100), mtype VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, mdate VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, operator VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, health_status VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT '状态良好', notes TEXT ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS maintainer ( id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, staff_no VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE, name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, gender VARCHAR(10) DEFAULT '男', phone VARCHAR(50), department VARCHAR(100), duty VARCHAR(100), status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT '在岗', entry_date VARCHAR(50), remark TEXT ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS plant_area ( id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, area_code VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE, area_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, maintainer_id INT, center_latitude DOUBLE, center_longitude DOUBLE, radius_m INT DEFAULT 200, boundary_json TEXT, status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT '启用' ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS maintainer_plant ( maintainer_id INT NOT NULL, pid VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, is_primary INT DEFAULT 1, status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT '有效', created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (maintainer_id, pid) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS admin_user ( id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, username VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE, password_hash VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, display_name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, role_code VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ADMIN', status INT DEFAULT 1, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS system_notice ( id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL, category VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT '养护通知', publisher VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT '绿化管理中心', priority VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT '普通', publish_date DATE NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT '发布' ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS animal ( id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, animal_no VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE, name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, species VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT NULL, category VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT '水禽鸟类', count INT DEFAULT 1, area_id INT DEFAULT NULL, area_name VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT '天府湖水域生态区', latitude DOUBLE DEFAULT NULL, longitude DOUBLE DEFAULT NULL, health_status VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT '健康活泼', diet_type VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT '专用禽粮/水草', feeding_cycle_days INT DEFAULT 1, next_feeding_date VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT NULL, keeper_name VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT '生态保育员', birth_date VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT NULL, pic_url VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT NULL, remark TEXT ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
ALTER TABLE plant ADD COLUMN area_id INT DEFAULT NULL
ALTER TABLE plant ADD COLUMN latitude DOUBLE DEFAULT NULL
ALTER TABLE plant ADD COLUMN longitude DOUBLE DEFAULT NULL
ALTER TABLE animal ADD COLUMN latitude DOUBLE DEFAULT NULL
ALTER TABLE animal ADD COLUMN longitude DOUBLE DEFAULT NULL

ALTER TABLE plant ADD COLUMN trim_period_days INT DEFAULT NULL
ALTER TABLE plant ADD COLUMN fertilize_period_days INT DEFAULT NULL
ALTER TABLE plant ADD COLUMN water_period_days INT DEFAULT NULL
ALTER TABLE plant ADD COLUMN pest_period_days INT DEFAULT NULL
ALTER TABLE plant ADD COLUMN next_trim_date DATE DEFAULT NULL
ALTER TABLE plant ADD COLUMN next_fertilize_date DATE DEFAULT NULL
ALTER TABLE plant ADD COLUMN next_water_date DATE DEFAULT NULL
ALTER TABLE plant ADD COLUMN next_pest_date DATE DEFAULT NULL
